a1.ENG: I’m a husband and a father of three, and I serve as a senior lecturer at a public university in Southern Malaysia. Outside of work, I enjoy hiking and I run half marathons. I am a tech enthusiast who enjoys exploring emerging AI and building websites and systems that simplify daily work and streamline business operations.

a2.ENG: Personal sites take 3–7 days. Corporate sites take 7–14 days. Complex systems depend on requirements.
a2.BM: Laman personal ambil 3–7 hari. Laman korporat 7–14 hari. Sistem kompleks bergantung pada keperluan.

a4.ENG: The package includes 1 year of free maintenance (technical support for bugs/errors). Content updates and new features after handover are charged separately.

q5.ENG: What Tech Stack do you use?

a5.ENG: We avoid using WordPress templates. Instead, we build from scratch using a "Mixed-Mode" approach—combining modern frameworks with AI-assisted coding to ensure high performance and precision.
a5.BM: Kami elakkan template WordPress. Kami bina dari kosong menggunakan pendekatan "Mixed-Mode"—menggabungkan framework moden dengan bantuan AI untuk prestasi tinggi dan ketepatan.
